info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Authorization Void-spec
info.description: The Authorization Void API allows users to cancel or void an existing authorization, helping to manage transaction states effectively. This endpoint is useful for merchants and payment processors who need to reverse authorizations that are no longer required. By providing the specific authorization ID, users can ensure the transaction is properly handled without incurring unnecessary charges. Typical consumers include financial institutions and businesses involved in online transactions, aiming to enhance operational accuracy and customer satisfaction.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to void an existing authorization request identified by a specific reference number. Upon successfully voiding the authorization, a confirmation of the action will be returned.

requestBody.description: This endpoint is used to void a specific authorization identified by the unique identifier RES-100045. The request must include all necessary information in JSON format to accurately process the void operation.
